Context: 6. T.A. for local journeys

1. T.A. for local journeys: Mileage allowance for the journeys performed on all the days spent on temporary duty and in addition 50% of the admissible D.A. Option is available either to claim reimbursement of conveyance hire charges under Delegation of Financial Powers Rules or to claim normal T.A. as above. - GIO (3) (b) (2), SR 71.
